interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to capture from. Each item has 'name' (string) and 'promiscuous' (bool). The '+' suffix is added if promiscuous is true, corresponding to the -i flag behavior in ncaptool(8). Use 'items' to define the flat map structure for list entries.

bpf_filter.description: BPF filter pattern for data sources, corresponding to the -b flag. Empty string means no filter.

output_file.description: Path to write ncap data to, corresponding to the -o flag. Use '-' for stdout.

count.description: Number of messages to process before stopping, corresponding to the -c flag. 0 means no limit.

interval.description: Time interval in seconds to process before stopping, corresponding to the -t flag. 0 means no limit.

post_process_cmd.description: Command to run on each new file for continuous operation, corresponding to the -k flag. Empty string means no command.

hide_source.description: Hide source IP addresses, corresponding to the 's' option of the -H flag.

hide_dest.description: Hide destination IP addresses, corresponding to the 'd' option of the -H flag.

debug.description: Increment debugging level, corresponding to the -d flag.

summary.description: Emit traffic summary to stderr on exit, corresponding to the -v flag.
